query: What other books did Agatha Christie write?
note: Single FindByAuthor. Author is the subject — must not route to Retrieve_by_Title or Retrieve_Author_Info.

query: Show me all the books in the Mistborn series.
note: Single FindSeries. Series referenced as a whole — not a title lookup.

query: Who is Haruki Murakami?
note: Single AuthorInfo. Author as a person — not their bibliography, not developer info.

query: What new books came out recently?
note: Single NewReleases. Pure recency framing with no other constraints.

query: What are the most popular books right now?
note: Single Popular. Consensus framing — not a sort-by-rating traits search.

query: Surprise me with a random book.
note: Single Random. Explicitly cedes the choice — no taste signal, so not Recommend.

query: What is The Great Gatsby about? No spoilers please.
note: FindByTitle then Summarize with spoiler_free=True. Simplest summarize chain.

query: What are the main themes of To Kill a Mockingbird?
note: FindByTitle then Themes. Interpretive ask about meaning — not Summarize.

query: In what order should I read the Chronicles of Narnia?
note: FindSeries then ReadingOrder. The canonical series + order pairing.

query: Is The Hunger Games appropriate for a 10-year-old?
note: FindByTitle then ReadingLevel with reader_context. Suitability ask on a named book.

query: How long would it take me to read War and Peace?
note: FindByTitle then ReadingTime. Time-to-finish ask on a named book.

query: Add Project Hail Mary to my reading list.
note: Single SaveToReadingList. Library write with one title.

query: What's on my reading list?
note: Single ViewReadingList. Library read — not UserInfo, not ReadingStats.

query: Remove Twilight from my reading list.
note: Single RemoveFromReadingList. Library write — removal intent.

query: I just finished The Martian.
note: Single MarkBookAsRead with no rating. Completion statement only.

query: Give Dune 5 stars.
note: Single RateBook. Standalone rating with no completion signal — not Mark_Book_As_Read.

query: How many books have I read this year?
note: Single ReadingStats with aspects=[books_read]. Stats ask — not the list itself.

query: What does everyone say about Neil Gaiman's writing style?
note: Single AuthorInfo with aspects=writing style. Author facts with a focus angle.

query: Find Dune by Frank Herbert.
note: DISCRIMINATION (updated 2026-07-28 when FindByTitle lost its authors hint field): named title plus author → Retrieve_by_Title + Retrieve_by_Author + Combine_Intersect, still NOT a bare Retrieve_by_Author. Mirror of 120, where the author alone is the subject and one node is correct.

query: Books by Frank Herbert.
note: DISCRIMINATION: mirror of 119 — author is the subject → Retrieve_by_Author, not Title or Traits.

query: Tell me about Brandon Sanderson and show me his books.
note: AuthorInfo + FindByAuthor in parallel. Two distinct author-domain asks in one message.

query: What are the best-rated fantasy books?
note: DISCRIMINATION: attribute search with sort_by=rating → FindByTraits, not Retrieve_Popular (no consensus framing).

query: What fantasy is everyone reading these days?
note: DISCRIMINATION: mirror of 122 — consensus framing ('everyone reading') → Retrieve_Popular with genre filter.

query: Any good sci-fi released in the last couple of years?
note: DISCRIMINATION: recency framing → NewReleases with genre filter, not FindByTraits with year math.

query: Pick anything for me — as long as it's a mystery under 300 pages with good ratings.
note: DISCRIMINATION: explicit 'pick anything' → Random with filters, not Recommend despite the constraints.

query: I'm in the mood for something melancholic and atmospheric.
note: DISCRIMINATION: mirror of 125 — mood carries taste signal → Analyze_Similar_Books, not Random.

query: Summarize 1984 and Animal Farm for me.
note: Two FindByTitle feeding one Summarize (or two). Multi-book summarize fan-in.

query: How do the themes of Dune and Foundation differ?
note: DISCRIMINATION: themes across two books → Compare with comparison_criteria=themes, not Analyze_Themes twice.

query: I read about 30 minutes a day — can I get through Anna Karenina in a month?
note: FindByTitle then ReadingTime with minutes_per_day=30. Tests parameter extraction into the analyze node.

query: Add Dune, Hyperion, and Left Hand of Darkness to my reading list.
note: Single SaveToReadingList with three titles — one node, not three.

query: Just finished Circe last night — easily 5 stars!
note: DISCRIMINATION: completion + rating in one breath → single Mark_Book_As_Read with rating, not Mark + Rate.

query: Show me what I'm currently reading.
note: Single ViewReadingList with status=reading. Status filter extraction.

query: What genres do I read the most, and what's my average rating?
note: Single ReadingStats with aspects=[genre_breakdown, average_rating]. Multi-aspect but one node.

query: Who wrote The Left Hand of Darkness, and what else did they write?
note: FindByTitle then FindByAuthor. The author for the second step comes from the first — sequential cross-tool dependency.

query: Is Blood Meridian too violent for a middle schooler? What about The Road?
note: Two FindByTitle then ReadingLevel (one node with two deps, or two level nodes). Suitability across two named books.

query: Put together a plan to get me into Russian classics over the next three months.
note: Retrieval for candidate classics then ReadingPlan with timeframe. Plan needs candidates first.

query: I loved Mistborn. Show me the rest of the series in reading order, estimate how long the whole thing takes at 45 minutes a day, and add them all to my reading list.
note: FindSeries → ReadingOrder → ReadingTime + SaveToReadingList. Four nodes with two analyze steps sharing one retrieval.

query: Compare the themes of 1984 and Brave New World, then recommend a modern dystopia based on the darker one, and add your recommendation to my reading list.
note: Two FindByTitle + Compare + Recommend + SaveToReadingList. Five nodes; the save depends conceptually on the recommend output.

query: Based on my reading history, what genres do I favor? Then recommend 3 books outside my comfort zone.
note: ReadingStats then Recommend. The recommendation inverts the stats output — cross-tier dependency from library data.

query: Who is Ursula K. Le Guin, what are her most well-known books, and which one should I start with?
note: AuthorInfo + FindByAuthor + ReadingOrder. Three asks about one author spanning info, bibliography, and entry point.

query: I just finished Project Hail Mary — 5 stars. Take it off my reading list and recommend something similar that came out in the last few years.
note: MarkBookAsRead + RemoveFromReadingList + FindByTitle + Recommend with recency filter. Two library writes plus a recommend chain in one message.

query: For The Brothers Karamazov: what are its themes, is it suitable for a smart 15-year-old, and how long would it take a slow reader to finish?
note: One FindByTitle feeding three parallel analyze nodes (Themes, ReadingLevel, ReadingTime). Maximum analyze fan-out from a single retrieval.

query: Plan my next three months of reading: mostly recent sci-fi releases plus one classic I haven't read yet — check my list — and nothing over 500 pages.
note: NewReleases + FindByTraits + ViewReadingList feeding a ReadingPlan. Three retrievals across catalog and library tiers converge on one plan node.

query: What's the most popular fantasy book right now, how does it compare to The Name of the Wind, and is it okay for a 13-year-old?
note: Popular + FindByTitle + Compare + ReadingLevel. Compare has one dynamic input (popular pick) and one named input.

query: Tell the developer I love the new reading list feature! Also, who built this app and what's it made with?
note: Feedback + DeveloperInfo + ProjectInfo. Three non-book domains in one message; feedback must not swallow the questions.

query: Rate Dune 5 stars and Dune Messiah 3 stars, then based on those ratings tell me whether I should continue the saga or jump ship to something else.
note: Two RateBook + Series/Recommend reasoning. Two library writes with different values feeding a recommendation.

query: Surprise me with a random classic, tell me what it's about without spoilers, estimate my reading time at 20 minutes a day, and add it to my list.
note: Random + Summarize + ReadingTime + SaveToReadingList. Every downstream node hangs off an unknown-at-plan-time random pick.

query: Check my reading stats, recommend 3 books like my top genre but from authors I've never read, put them in reading order, estimate total time at 30 minutes a day, add all three to my list, and tell the developer the stats feature is brilliant.
note: ReadingStats + Recommend + ReadingOrder + ReadingTime + SaveToReadingList + Feedback. Six-plus nodes spanning library, analyze, and project tiers — the extended-catalog kitchen sink.
